pool.text: Ibadan came into existence during a period of turmoil that characterized Yorubaland at the time.
The Sokoto Caliphate was decisively defeated by the armies of Ibadan, halting their progress.
David and Anna Hinderer arrived to build a mission and a church in Ibadan.
The Ibadan area became a British Protectorate after a treaty signed by Fijabi.
The Ibadan recreational club was established in the Sabo area of the city.
The Bower's Tower was built to the east on Oke Aàre.
Ibadan was chosen as the headquarters of the Western Provinces.
The city hosted the first TV station in Africa, Western Nigeria Television.
Ibadan was the largest and most populous city in Nigeria.
Shooting stars football club won Nigeria's first international trophy, the African Cup Winners' Cup.
Ibadan joined the UNESCO Global Network of Learning Cities.
Ibadan was ranked one of the fastest-growing cities in sub-Saharan Africa.
Ibadan was the site of a failed coup attempt by Yoruba separatists.
